title: Fix version parsing and SSH config comment handling

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Plan: (1) Fix version parsing to extract first semver-like triplet via grep -oE instead of stripping non-digits. (2) Strip inline comments and quotes from IdentityFile values and SSH directive values.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Delivered: Fixed version parsing (grep -oE for semver triplet instead of sed strip), added strip_ssh_value() helper for inline comments and quotes, applied to audit/apply SSH directives and IdentityFile scanning. 9 new tests (62 total, all passing).
